title: 1. Bubble-Bubble Fruit (Awa Awa no Mi)
facts: Fruit look from the user's oparchive screenshots (refs/batch3/DESIGNS.md)

plan.fruit: Drawn from the design you sent (refs/batch3).

lines.text: You take a bite#red of a weird lavender#purple fruit.
lines.say: You take a bite of a weird lavender fruit.

lines.text: Don't panic,#red that's just a Devil#purple Fruit.#purple
lines.say: Don't panic, that's just a Devil Fruit.

lines.text: Out of every fruit in the sea,#blue
lines.say: Out of every fruit in the sea,

lines.text: a Paramecia#orange that makes soap bubbles#blue come out of your body.
lines.say: a Paramecia that makes soap bubbles come out of your body.

lines.text: First, your bubbles clean anything#blue spotless#green in seconds.
lines.say: First, your bubbles clean anything spotless in seconds.

lines.text: Then the bubbles wash away people's strength,#orange so they go weak and slippery.#pink
lines.say: Then the bubbles wash away people's strength, so they go weak and slippery.

lines.text: You can even make the ground#orange so slippery#gold that nobody can stand up.
lines.say: You can even make the ground so slippery that nobody can stand up.

lines.text: Your strongest#blue move is Golden Awa: a giant wave of bubbles#pink that cleans an enemy right out of power.
lines.say: Your strongest move is Golden Awa: a giant wave of bubbles that cleans an enemy right out of power.

lines.text: Once the bubbles#orange wash off, the strength#blue comes right back.
lines.say: Once the bubbles wash off, the strength comes right back.

lines.text: Kalifa, the CP9 secretary,#gold used it against#green Nami at Enies Lobby.
lines.say: Kalifa, the CP9 secretary, used it against Nami at Enies Lobby.

lines.text: Users of this fruit never need a bath.#orange
lines.say: Users of this fruit never need a bath.

lines.text: Which fruit#pink do you want next?#gold Follow for more.
lines.say: Which fruit do you want next? Follow for more.
